qualifier: driven and tuned by B cell receptor signaling
name: B cell receptor signaling and B cell activation
rationale: All members concern BCR signaling, its positive/negative regulation and resulting B cell proliferation/differentiation, distinguishing it from TCR/costimulation (C1) and B cell surface/germinal-centre signatures (C2-C4).

qualifier: substrate adhesion with Rho kinase and ILK complex signaling
name: Integrin-dependent cell spreading and substrate-attached migration
rationale: Members cover integrin signaling, substrate-dependent spreading/migration and the RHO-PAK/ROCK and PINCH-ILK-parvin cytoskeletal links, unlike the fibronectin-matrix, platelet and Rap1/MAPK confusables.

qualifier: meiosis, transposon silencing and maternal-to-zygotic transition
name: Meiosis, germline transposon silencing and maternal-to-zygotic transition
rationale: Members span meiotic chromosome mechanics, piRNA/KRAB/HUSH retroelement silencing, gamete chromatin and zygotic genome activation, whereas confusables centre on sperm motility, zona binding and gonadal hormones.

qualifier: GDP-mannose and dolichyl-phosphate mannose, with their CDG defects
name: Mannosyl donor synthesis and its congenital glycosylation disorders
rationale: All members concern synthesis of GDP-mannose and dolichol-P-mannose (MPI, PMM2, PGM1, DPM1-3, DOLK, SRD5A3) and their CDGs, unlike confusables covering ALG oligosaccharide assembly or dolichol synthesis alone.

qualifier: nuclear vRNP trafficking and host shutoff
name: Influenza virus RNP replication, nuclear trafficking and host shutoff
rationale: Members describe influenza vRNA/mRNA synthesis, vRNP import/export and NS1-mediated PKR and host mRNA inhibition, distinguishing it from coronavirus and RSV replication confusables.

qualifier: plus RNA pseudouridylation and editing
name: tRNA processing, aminoacylation and RNA base modification
rationale: Most members are nuclear/mitochondrial tRNA processing, modification and cytosolic/mitochondrial aminoacylation, with related RNA pseudouridylation and editing, whereas confusables lack aminoacylation and emphasise rRNA/mitoribosome or wybutosine/t6A modification.

qualifier: ISG15 conjugation and type I/II interferon signatures, not sensing
name: Interferon-stimulated antiviral effector response and ISG15 conjugation
rationale: Members are IFN-alpha/gamma response signatures, ISG15 and host restriction of viral replication, distinguishing it from RIG-I/IRF3/TLR sensing (C1, C3) and Th1/MHC II IFN-gamma (C2) confusables.

qualifier: via incretin, glucagon and fatty-acid G protein-coupled receptors
name: Islet hormone secretion via incretin, glucagon and fatty-acid receptors
rationale: Members cover GLP-1/GIP, glucagon, somatostatin, acetylcholine and free fatty acid receptor regulation of insulin and glucagon secretion, unlike calcitonin/amylin, adrenergic/PKA and KATP-channel confusables.

qualifier: with adherens junction maintenance
name: Epithelial apical-basal polarity and adherens junction maintenance
rationale: All members concern epithelial polarity, apical constriction and adherens junction maintenance, distinguishing them from desmosome, adherens-junction assembly and podocyte confusables.

qualifier: with inhibitory immunoreceptor regulation
name: Fc-gamma receptor signaling and inhibitory immunoreceptor regulation
rationale: Members combine FcgR activation with inhibitory receptor control (CD22, SIRP, inhibitory Fc signaling, suppressed phagocytosis/neutrophil activation), unlike hypersensitivity/ADCC and FCGR3A phagocytosis confusables.

qualifier: glycogen synthase, branching and lysosomal glycophagy defects
name: Glycogen synthesis, glycophagy and glycogen storage diseases
rationale: Members are glycogen synthesis/breakdown, glycophagy and GSD 0, II, IV, XV and Lafora disease, whereas confusables centre on G6PC/glucokinase and hexose phosphate transport.

qualifier: ATP release and calcium entry
name: Mechanosensitive ATP release and calcium entry channels
rationale: Members span mechanical/pressure responses, ATP export, calcium influx, cell volume, blebbing and gap-junction transmission, unlike endothelial shear-stress, connexin-trafficking and glutamate receptor confusables.

qualifier: PAPS and nucleotide-sugar synthesis and transport
name: PAPS sulfate donor and nucleotide-sugar synthesis and transport
rationale: Members concern PAPS and UDP-sugar formation and transport and their skeletal dysplasias (PAPSS2, SLC26A2, SLC35D1), unlike GAG biosynthesis, selenium and SLC35 CDG confusables.

core: Nephric duct and ureteric bud formation
qualifier: from intermediate mesoderm induction
name: Intermediate mesoderm to nephric duct and ureteric bud formation
rationale: Members cover intermediate mesoderm, nephric/mesonephric duct and ureteric bud formation and branching, with intermediate mesoderm and organ induction absent from all confusables.

qualifier: mitochondrial and death-receptor pathways, execution and necroptosis
name: Intrinsic and extrinsic apoptosis, execution phase and necroptosis
rationale: Members span BCL-2 family/MOMP, apoptosome, death-receptor/caspase-8, DNA fragmentation and necroptosis, unlike p53-transcriptional, T cell activation-induced and autophagic death confusables.

qualifier: inducing IL-12, IL-23 and IL-10 production
name: C-type lectin receptor antifungal sensing and cytokine induction
rationale: Members are Dectin-1/2 and DC-SIGN fungal recognition and the cytokine production they drive, whereas confusables are downstream interleukin receptor signaling.

qualifier: in bone marrow, thymus and developing kidney
name: Proliferation control in bone marrow, thymus and developing kidney
rationale: Members regulate cell proliferation, apoptosis and differentiation in hematopoietic tissues and metanephric development, the kidney arm separating it from hematopoietic confusables and the marrow/thymus arm from the kidney confusable.

core: Cellular response to mechanical membrane stress
qualifier: blebbing, membrane repair and volume control
name: Membrane mechanical stress response with blebbing and repair
rationale: Members concern hydrostatic/mechanical load, bleb assembly, membrane repair and cell volume, unlike the phospholipid scrambling and apoptotic clearance confusables.

qualifier: from otic vesicle to cochlea, canals and nerve
name: Inner ear structural morphogenesis from otic vesicle
rationale: All members build inner ear structures (otic vesicle, cochlea, semicircular canals, vestibulocochlear nerve), unlike eye, craniofacial, pharyngeal gland and hair cell/vestibular function confusables.

core: Adipocyte fatty acid and glycerol flux
qualifier: in thermogenesis and fatty acid sensing
name: Adipocyte fatty acid and glycerol flux in thermogenesis
rationale: Members cover fatty acid and glycerol transport, aquaglyceroporin export, free fatty acid receptors and cold/diet thermogenesis, unlike adipocyte differentiation and water aquaporin confusables.

core: Endocrine control of feeding and growth
qualifier: leptin, growth hormone, prolactin and glucocorticoid axes
name: Endocrine control of appetite, body growth and glucocorticoid secretion
rationale: Members are leptin/ghrelin appetite control, GH/prolactin receptor signaling and cortisol/ACTH secretion, unlike GI peptide GPCR, neuropeptide behavior and stress-response confusables.

qualifier: with pseudouridylation and mitoribosome assembly
name: Mitochondrial RNA modification, pseudouridylation and mitoribosome assembly
rationale: Members concern mitochondrial tRNA/rRNA/mRNA processing and modification, RNA pseudouridylation and mitoribosome assembly, unlike tRNA aminoacylation and mitochondrial transcription/replication confusables.

qualifier: arginine, lysine and ornithine transporters and their defects
name: Cationic amino acid transport and its inherited defects
rationale: All members concern transport of arginine, lysine and ornithine and the SLC7A7/SLC25A15 disorders, unlike urea cycle enzyme, organic anion and neutral amino acid transport confusables.

qualifier: with early embryonic stem and germ cell lineages
name: Placental trophoblast development and early embryonic stem cell lineages
rationale: Members cover trophoblast differentiation/migration, labyrinth and decidua formation plus inner cell mass, germline and stem cell maintenance, unlike mammary, ocular and germ cell confusables.

qualifier: compartment-specific interconversion
name: Compartment-specific phosphoinositide and inositol phosphate synthesis
rationale: All members concern synthesis and interconversion of PIPs at specific membranes and soluble inositol phosphates, whereas confusables are ER lipid transfer, tethering and membrane traffic.
